price.note: Reported as a cheap monthly service cost (~800 ₹) for a typical user.
price.meaning: revenue per active customer per month

variable_cost.note: Derived from commissary kitchen rent (₹60‑120k) spread over 8‑15 tenant brands; includes utilities and basic staffing per brand.
variable_cost.meaning: cost to serve one active customer per month (servicing, delivery, support, payment, insurance)

cac.note: Typical digital acquisition cost for B2C food‑delivery subscriptions in Indian metro markets; conservative range based on online ad CPM and referral incentives.
cac.meaning: cost to acquire one paying customer

churn.note: Monthly churn for subscription‑style meal services in India usually falls between 5‑12% according to industry benchmarks.
churn.meaning: share of customers who cancel each month (0-1)

fixed_cost.note: Includes team salaries, office rent, software licences, and overhead for a small cloud‑kitchen operation in Mumbai; ranges reflect lean vs. modest staffing.
fixed_cost.meaning: fixed operating cost per month (team, rent, software)
